contract.variant: Turkish get-up with a high bridge, bell in the left hand; the knee sweeps straight into a half-kneel and the top is a tall split stance
contract.counting: One full get-up to standing and back down
contract.phases: Lie with the bell pressed; roll onto the planted right elbow; post on the hand; high bridge; sweep the straight leg under the hips so the knee lands with the shin pointing back; push off the hand to an upright half-kneel; stand tall into a split stance; reverse every step
contract.contacts: Bell-side foot planted throughout; elbow, hand, heel, knee and back toes pinned in their stages; back and forearm roll on the floor during the roll; bell arm vertical throughout
